_doc: Deployed surfaces the verify-site check proves are SHAREABLE (not merely deployed). Reviewed file content, not a `vars.` context: an unset repository variable and an empty one render identically in a workflow, so nothing downstream can fail closed on the difference (workflow_env_lint, empty-env class). Config lives here so a URL change is a reviewed diff.
